cmмотрим على الوضع الحالي لـ RLS في الـ schema قبل ما أبدأ.

ملف الـ schema بين أيديّ. قبل ما أكتب السياسات الجديدة، لازم أعرف نموذج الصلاحيات الفعلي بتاع التطبيق عشان الـ RLS يطابق ما التطبيق بيفرضه على الواجهة — وإلا هيكسر وظائف. خليني أقرأ بوابة التبويبات ومعالجة أخطاء المزامنة.

دلوقتي عندي نموذج الصلاحيات الكامل. لازم أقرا `syncFromCloud` عشان أعرف إزاي بتتعامل مع فشل أي مجموعة — ده هيحدد لو تقييد الـ SELECT هيكسر المزامنة للموظفين.

مهم جداً: المزامنة بتعتمد على إن RLS بيمنع القراءة برجوع مصفوفة فاضية (مش error)، فتقييد الـ SELECT آمن. بس لازم أتأكد من مسارين بيحددوا مين بيكتب في `financial_accounts`: مستمع الريال تايم (هل بيشغل المطابقة على أجهزة الموظفين؟) وشاشة الموظفين. أقرأهم دلوقتي.

اكتشفت نقطة مهمة: مستمع الريال تايم بيشتغل على **كل** الأجهزة بغض النظر عن الدور، فالمطابقة بتكتب في `sales_orders` و`financial_accounts` من أي جهاز. لازم أتأكد من كل الكتابات السحابية لـ `profiles` و`company_settings` و`financial_accounts` ومين بيطلقها.

دلوقتي عرفت كل الكتابات السحابية. في نقطة حساسة: هل الموظف العادي يقدر يحذف عملاء/طلبات/تصاريح من الواجهة؟ لأن هقفل DELETE على super_admin، فلازم أتأكد إن مفيش شاشة بتخلي موظف عادي يحذف. أفتش على بوابات الحذف والأدوار.

في `MyProfileModal` — ممكن الموظف يعدّل بياناته الشخصية. لازم أتأكد هل ده بيكتب في `profiles` السحابية، عشان هسمح بالتحديث الذاتي مع استبعاد الدور والصلاحيات. أوضح كمان أزرار الحذف في الطلبات والتصاريح.

في ثلاث مسارات بتكتب `profiles` من أجهزة عادية: `MyProfileModal` (تعديل ذاتي)، و`LoginScreen:102` (عند الدخول)، و`saveProfile`. لازم أقرأهم بالتفصيل قبل ما أصمم استثناء التحديث الذاتي.

أكمل قراءة `updateOwnProfile` و`changeOwnPassword` ونداء `LoginScreen:102`.

خلصت رسم الصورة. آخر حاجة محتاج أتأكد منها: هل شاشة المحافظ بتخلي المحاسب يضيف/يعدّل حسابات؟ وهل في مسارات حذف تانية للطلبات/التصاريح؟

شاشة المح/apis مفيش عليها بوابة دور خالص (معتمدة على تبويب super_admin+accountant). أتأكد من زراير الحذف فيها ومن إن مفيش ميزة حذف تصريح حية.

275	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
276	RETURNS trigger
277	LANGUAGE plpgsql
278	SECURITY DEFINER
279	SET search_path = public
280	AS $$
281	BEGIN
282	  INSERT INTO public.profiles (
283	    id, full_name, username, phone_number, whatsapp_number, role, is_active
284	  )
285	  VALUES (
286	    new.id,
287	    COALESCE(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name', ''),
288	    COALESCE(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'username', split_part(new.email, '@', 1)),
289	    COALESCE(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'phone_number', ''),
290	    COALESCE(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'whatsapp_number', ''),
291	    COALESCE((new.raw_user_meta_data->>'role')::user_role_enum, 'sales'),
292	    TRUE
293	  )
294	  ON CONFLICT (username) DO UPDATE
295	  SET id = EXCLUDED.id,
296	      is_active = TRUE,
297	      updated_at = now();
298	
299	  RETURN NEW;
300	END;
301	$$;

304	CREATE TRIGGER on_auth_user_created
305	    AFTER INSERT ON auth.users
306	    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user();

311	-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
312	-- 6. الأمان — تفعيل RLS على كل الجداول وإعادة بناء السياسات بصيغة موحدة
313	--    المبدأ: لا قراءة ولا كتابة لأي حد مجهول (anon) إلا استثناءً معلناً أدناه.
314	--    حذف كل سياسة قائمة ثم إنشاء القائمة القياسية — التكرار لا يضاعف سياسات.
315	-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
316	ALTER TABLE company_settings   ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
317	ALTER TABLE financial_accounts ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
318	ALTER TABLE profiles           ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
319	ALTER TABLE customers          ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
320	ALTER TABLE permits            ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
321	ALTER TABLE sales_orders       ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
322	ALTER TABLE order_permits      ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
323	ALTER TABLE sms_messages       ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
324	ALTER TABLE audit_logs         ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
325	
326	DO $$
327	DECLARE t TEXT;
328	        p RECORD;
329	BEGIN
330	    FOREACH t IN ARRAY ARRAY[
331	        'company_settings','financial_accounts','profiles','customers','permits',
332	        'sales_orders','order_permits','sms_messages','audit_logs'
333	    ]
334	    LOOP
335	        -- تشغيل RLS نفسه (بدونه كل السياسات مبتدرة)
336	        EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE public.%I ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY', t);
337	        -- حذف كل السياسات القائمة (بغض النظر عن الاسم)
338	        FOR p IN SELECT policyname FROM pg_policies
339	                 WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = t
340	        LOOP
341	            EXECUTE format('DROP POLICY %I ON public.%I', p.policyname, t);
342	        END LOOP;
343	    END LOOP;
344	END $$;
345	
346	-- قراءة/كتابة للمستخدمين المصادقين فقط على كل الجداول
347	CREATE POLICY "authenticated read company_settings"   ON company_settings   FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
348	CREATE POLICY "authenticated write company_settings"  ON company_settings   FOR ALL    TO authenticated USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);
349	CREATE POLICY "authenticated read financial_accounts" ON financial_accounts FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
350	CREATE POLICY "authenticated write financial_accounts" ON financial_accounts FOR ALL   TO authenticated USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);
351	CREATE POLICY "authenticated read profiles"           ON profiles           FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
352	CREATE POLICY "authenticated write profiles"          ON profiles           FOR ALL    TO authenticated USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);
353	CREATE POLICY "authenticated read customers"          ON customers          FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
354	CREATE POLICY "authenticated write customers"         ON customers          FOR ALL    TO authenticated USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);
355	CREATE POLICY "authenticated read permits"            ON permits            FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
356	CREATE POLICY "authenticated write permits"           ON permits            FOR ALL    TO authenticated USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);
357	CREATE POLICY "authenticated read sales_orders"       ON sales_orders       FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
358	CREATE POLICY "authenticated write sales_orders"      ON sales_orders       FOR ALL    TO authenticated USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);
359	CREATE POLICY "authenticated read order_permits"      ON order_permits      FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
360	CREATE POLICY "authenticated write order_permits"     ON order_permits      FOR ALL    TO authenticated USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);
361	CREATE POLICY "authenticated read sms_messages"       ON sms_messages       FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
362	CREATE POLICY "authenticated write sms_messages"      ON sms_messages       FOR ALL    TO authenticated USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);
363

365	CREATE POLICY "anon self-register customers" ON customers
366	  FOR INSERT TO anon

385	-- 7.1 سحب وتخصيص تصريح لعميل
386	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION rpc_claim_permit(
387	    p_permit_id UUID,
388	    p_customer_id UUID,
389	    p_order_id UUID,
390	    p_user_id UUID
391	)
392	RETURNS JSONB
393	LANGUAGE plpgsql
394	SECURITY DEFINER
395	AS $$
396	DECLARE
397	    v_permit permits%ROWTYPE;
398	BEGIN
399	    SELECT * INTO v_permit FROM permits WHERE id = p_permit_id FOR UPDATE;
400	
401	    IF NOT FOUND THEN
402	        RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'message', 'التصريح غير موجود');
403	    END IF;
404	
405	    IF v_permit.status != 'available' THEN
406	        RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'message', 'عذراً، هذا التصريح تم حجزه بالفعل من موظف آخر لحظياً');
407	    END IF;
408	
409	    UPDATE permits
410	    SET
411	        status = 'assigned',
412	        assigned_to_customer_id = p_customer_id,
413	        assigned_by_user_id = p_user_id,
414	        assigned_at = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Riyadh'),
415	        updated_at = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Riyadh')
416	    WHERE id = p_permit_id;
417	
418	    IF p_order_id IS NOT NULL THEN
419	        INSERT INTO order_permits (order_id, permit_id)
420	        VALUES (p_order_id, p_permit_id)
421	        ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
422	    END IF;
423	
424	    INSERT INTO audit_logs (user_id, action_type, entity_name, entity_id, details)
425	    VALUES (
426	        p_user_id,
427	        'CLAIM_PERMIT',
428	        'permits',
429	        p_permit_id,
430	        jsonb_build_object('customer_id', p_customer_id, 'order_id', p_order_id)
431	    );
432	
433	    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'message', 'تم تخصيص التصريح بنجاح', 'permit_id', p_permit_id);
434	END;
435	$$;
436	
437	-- 7.2 إرجاع التصريح للمخزون
438	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION rpc_return_permit(
439	    p_permit_id UUID,
440	    p_user_id UUID,
441	    p_reason TEXT DEFAULT 'إلغاء من قبل العميل'
442	)
443	RETURNS JSONB
444	LANGUAGE plpgsql
445	SECURITY DEFINER
446	AS $$
447	DECLARE
448	    v_permit permits%ROWTYPE;
449	BEGIN
450	    SELECT * INTO v_permit FROM permits WHERE id = p_permit_id FOR UPDATE;
451	
452	    IF NOT FOUND THEN
453	        RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'message', 'التصريح غير موجود');
454	    END IF;
455	
456	    IF v_permit.status != 'assigned' AND v_permit.status != 'locked' THEN
457	        RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'message', 'التصريح ليس في حالة مخصصة ليتم إرجاعه');
458	    END IF;
459	
460	    DELETE FROM order_permits WHERE permit_id = p_permit_id;
461	
462	    UPDATE permits
463	    SET
464	        status = 'available',
465	        assigned_to_customer_id = NULL,
466	        assigned_by_user_id = NULL,
467	        assigned_at = NULL,
468	        locked_by_user_id = NULL,
469	        locked_at = NULL,
470	        updated_at = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Riyadh')
471	    WHERE id = p_permit_id;
472	
473	    INSERT INTO audit_logs (user_id, action_type, entity_name, entity_id, details)
474	    VALUES (
475	        p_user_id,
476	        'RETURN_PERMIT',
477	        'permits',
478	        p_permit_id,
479	        jsonb_build_object('reason', p_reason, 'previous_customer_id', v_permit.assigned_to_customer_id)
480	    );
481	
482	    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'message', 'تم إرجاع التصريح للمخزون بنجاح');
483	END;
484	$$;
485	
486	-- 7.3 مطابقة سداد SMS وتحديث الطلب ذرياً
487	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION rpc_match_sms_payment(
488	    p_sms_id UUID,
489	    p_order_id UUID,
490	    p_user_id UUID
491	)
492	RETURNS JSONB
493	LANGUAGE plpgsql
494	SECURITY DEFINER
495	AS $$
496	DECLARE
497	    v_sms sms_messages%ROWTYPE;
498	    v_order sales_orders%ROWTYPE;
499	BEGIN
500	    SELECT * INTO v_sms FROM sms_messages WHERE id = p_sms_id FOR UPDATE;
501	    SELECT * INTO v_order FROM sales_orders WHERE id = p_order_id FOR UPDATE;
502	
503	    IF NOT FOUND THEN
504	        RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'message', 'بيانات الرسالة أو الطلب غير موجودة');
505	    END IF;
506	
507	    IF v_sms.status = 'matched' THEN
508	        RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'message', 'هذه الرسالة تم احتسابها ومطابقتها مسبقاً');
509	    END IF;
510	
511	    UPDATE sms_messages
512	    SET
513	        status = 'matched',
514	        matched_order_id = p_order_id,
515	        matched_by_user_id = p_user_id,
516	        matched_at = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Riyadh')
517	    WHERE id = p_sms_id;
518	
519	    UPDATE sales_orders
520	    SET
521	        paid_amount = paid_amount + COALESCE(v_sms.parsed_amount, 0),
522	        order_status = CASE
523	            WHEN (paid_amount + COALESCE(v_sms.parsed_amount, 0)) >= total_amount THEN 'confirmed'
524	            ELSE order_status
525	        END,
526	        updated_at = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Riyadh')
527	    WHERE id = p_order_id;
528	
529	    INSERT INTO audit_logs (user_id, action_type, entity_name, entity_id, details)
530	    VALUES (
531	        p_user_id,
532	        'MATCH_SMS',
533	        'sales_orders',
534	        p_order_id,
535	        jsonb_build_object('sms_id', p_sms_id, 'amount', v_sms.parsed_amount)
536	    );
537	
538	    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'message', 'تم تأكيد السداد وربط الدفعة بنجاح');
539	END;
540	$$;

543	-- 8. الريال تايم — البث اللحظي لكل الجداول (يشمل أحداث الحذف)
544	-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
545	-- Supabase ينشئ publication الافتراضي بـ publish='insert, update' فقط —
546	-- بدون السطر التالي أحداث الحذف لا تصل الأجهزة أبداً.
547	ALTER PUBLICATION supabase_realtime SET (publish = 'insert, update, delete');
548	
549	DO $$
550	DECLARE
551	    tbl TEXT;
552	BEGIN
553	    FOREACH tbl IN ARRAY ARRAY[
554	        'company_settings','financial_accounts','profiles','customers','permits',
555	        'sales_orders','order_permits','sms_messages','audit_logs'
556	    ]
557	    LOOP
558	        BEGIN
559	            EXECUTE format('ALTER PUBLICATION supabase_realtime ADD TABLE public.%I', tbl);
560	            RAISE NOTICE '✅ Added % to supabase_realtime', tbl;
561	        EXCEPTION
562	            WHEN duplicate_object THEN
563	                RAISE NOTICE '⏭️ % already in supabase_realtime — skipped', tbl;
564	        END;
565	    END LOOP;
566	END $$;
567

570	-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
571	-- دور admin لازم يكون super_admin:
572	-- SELECT username, role FROM public.profiles ORDER BY created_at;
573	--
574	-- السياسات القياسية على كل جدول (لازم profiles = 2، audit_logs = 2، إلخ):
575	-- SELECT tablename, policyname FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname='public' ORDER BY tablename;
576	--
577	-- كل الجداول مسجلة في الريال تايم مع الحذف:
578	-- SELECT pubname, schemaname, tablename FROM pg_publication_tables WHERE pubname='supabase_realtime';

#### Thinking

Now I understand the sync. Key observations:

1. `syncFromCloud` is one big try/catch. Each group reads via `sb.from('...').select(...)`. The result `data` would be `null` on error (RLS denial returns empty array actually — RLS returns no rows, not an error, for SELECT. With PostgREST, if RLS policy denies, you get an empty array `[]`, not an error). Actually with Supabase/PostgREST, a SELECT with no matching RLS policy returns an empty result set (no error). So restricting SELECT wouldn't cause an error — it would just return `[]`.

Wait, important nuance: with RLS, if a user has NO policy for SELECT on a table, PostgREST returns an empty array (not an error). So `data = []`. Then `mappedCusts.length > 0` guard means it doesn't overwrite local storage. Good — that's actually the designed behavior already ("بعد تقفيل RLS تصبح القراءة المجهولة فاضية").

BUT — there's a subtle danger: if a `sales` user can't read `financial_accounts`, sync returns `[]`, and local accounts are preserved (guard). Fine. But the ordering: sync reads customers BEFORE orders, and orders need custMap from local customers. If a sales user can read customers, fine.

Actually wait — there's a bigger issue. The whole sync is inside ONE try/catch. RLS denials on SELECT return empty arrays, not exceptions, so the try/catch won't be triggered. Good.

However, one thing to be careful about: PostgREST returns an empty set when RLS filters rows. It does NOT error. So restricting SELECT per-role is safe for sync (just yields empty → keeps local data).

2. Now the write paths. This is the crux. Which roles write to which tables?

Let me enumerate from dataService (from memory + report):
- **profiles**: super_admin creates/edits employees (EmployeesAndRolesView). Also syncFromCloud upserts missing local profiles (line 521) — done by ANY logged-in user on their own device! This is important: every user's sync pushes their local profiles to cloud. If I restrict profiles writes to super_admin only, then a sales user's sync would fail to push profiles. But wait — does the sales user even have local profiles to push? They get profiles via sync from cloud (step 6). The `missingProfilesOnCloud` = local profiles not on cloud. After step 6 sync, local = cloud merge, so missing should be empty usually. But there's an edge: a fresh device where the user logs in — profiles local = initialProfiles (mockData with default hashes). Actually on login, `getProfiles()` reads local storage or initialProfiles. Hmm, on a brand-new device, before first sync, local profiles = initialProfiles (5 mock employees). Those would be "missing on cloud" and get pushed! That's the H-5 chicken-and-egg thing partially.

Actually wait, this matters a lot for the RLS design. If a `sales` user logs in on a new device, sync runs, finds 5 local mock profiles not on cloud, and tries to upsert them. If profiles INSERT is restricted to super_admin, this upsert fails (console.error, swallowed). That's arguably GOOD — we don't want mock profiles with default passwords pushed to cloud. But it also means... hmm, actually the mock profiles have the same usernames as cloud ones (admin, sales, sara...), so `cloudProfileUsernames` check would match them (case-insensitive) and they'd be excluded from missing. So on a new device, after step 6 pulls cloud profiles, the local mock ones are replaced. Actually step 6 only replaces if `profileList.length > 0`. Then localOnlyProfiles = stored profiles not matching cloud ids/usernames. The mock profiles match by username → excluded. So missingProfilesOnCloud should be empty. OK.

But there's the initialProfiles id-migration concern. Let me not over-think; the key point: restricting profiles write to super_admin is correct per the app model (only super_admin has the employees tab). The sync push of profiles is a secondary path that would fail silently for non-admins — and since cloud profiles are pulled in the same sync, non-admins don't need to push.

Hmm wait, but actually there's a scenario: super_admin creates a new employee on device A. That employee's profile is upserted to cloud by super_admin (allowed). Then employee logs in on device B — their own profile must exist in cloud already. Fine.

But what about the NEW employee's initial local profile creation? In dataService.addEmployee or similar, it saves locally then upserts to cloud. Only super_admin does this. Fine.

3. **Role escalation protection**: The critical C-2 fix. `profiles` writes must be restricted to super_admin, AND crucially a user must not be able to change their OWN role. With `FOR ALL TO authenticated USING(true)`, a sales user could `update profiles set role='super_admin' where id=<their own id>`. 

So for profiles:
- SELECT: authenticated (all staff need to read profiles — sync does, and audit name resolution does). Actually do all roles need to read profiles? The sync step 6 reads profiles for ALL users. And audit log name resolution uses `this.getProfiles()` (local). Orders show createdBy. Dashboard reports show employee names. Yes, all authenticated users need SELECT on profiles. But should a sales user see other employees' data? profiles has no passwords in cloud (passwords are local only). It has role, phone, custom_permissions. Reading is needed for the app to function (sync, name resolution, permission display). I'll keep SELECT for all authenticated — the risk is low (no secrets), and restricting it would break sync for non-admins which would break their local data. Actually, hmm — but the sync guard `if (profileList && profileList.length > 0)` — if a sales user can't read profiles, they get [] → local profiles preserved (mock with default passwords). That's actually the H-5 security hole (default passwords work). Keeping SELECT open to authenticated is the safer choice for correctness. The report's C-2 concern is about WRITE escalation, not read.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.staff_role()
RETURNS user_role_enum
LANGUAGE sql
SECURITY DEFINER
STABLE
SET search_path = public
```

#### Thinking

Now I have a full picture of cloud writes:

**company_settings**: only `saveCompanySettings` (line 966, upsert) — called from CompanySettingsView (super_admin only tab). → Restrict write to super_admin. ✓

**profiles**:
- line 521: sync push (any device, upsert missing locals) — analyzed, normally empty for non-admins.
- line 1099: `addEmployee`/`updateEmployee`? (upsert) — need to check who calls. It's in the employee save flow → super_admin only (employees tab).
- line 1137: delete profile — super_admin only.
→ Restrict profiles INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE to super_admin. ✓

**financial_accounts**:
- line 1042: upsert (add/update account) — accounts tab → super_admin + accountant. Hmm, so INSERT/UPDATE account details needed by accountant too.
- line 2466/3054: demo seed inserts (demo tools — now DEV-only, and super_admin gated). 
- line 2581: SMS match balance update — any device.
- line 2687: manual payment balance update — orders tab users (super_admin/sales/accountant).
- line 2901: wipeAllData delete — super_admin only now (H-7 fix).
→ So: INSERT/UPDATE (full row) needed by super_admin + accountant; UPDATE current_balance needed by all authenticated; DELETE by super_admin only.

Hmm, the line 1042 upsert is full-row (account details) from the accounts management screen → accountant needs full UPDATE. And balance UPDATE needed by sales. So: allow UPDATE for all authenticated but restrict INSERT/DELETE to super_admin... but accountant should be able to ADD a wallet? The accounts tab allows accountant (reports permission). Does the accounts screen allow adding/editing accounts for accountant? Let me check FinancialAccountsView for create/edit buttons and role gating.

Actually — hold on. Let me reconsider. Simpler and safer: allow INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on financial_accounts for super_admin + accountant, and allow UPDATE (balance-only... can't restrict to column) for all authenticated.

But wait: if sales can UPDATE any column of financial_accounts (not just balance), they could tamper. The app only ever sends `{current_balance}` from those paths. But a malicious sales user with the anon key + their JWT could craft any update. RLS WITH CHECK can enforce that only current_balance changed:

```sql
CREATE POLICY "staff update account balance" ON financial_accounts
  FOR UPDATE TO authenticated
  USING (true)
  WITH CHECK (
    -- لا يُسمح إلا بتغيير الرصيد فقط — باقي الأعمدة ثابتة
    (row_to_json(new)::jsonb - 'current_balance' - 'updated_at') =
    (row_to_json(old)::jsonb - 'current_balance' - 'updated_at')
  );
```

Hmm, `row_to_json` comparison — that's a neat trick but `updated_at` differs... actually the app sends only current_balance, so updated_at isn't auto-updated (no trigger on financial_accounts for updated_at — there's no such trigger in the schema). So new.updated_at = old.updated_at unless changed. The `- 'updated_at'` exclusion makes it robust. This is elegant and enforces balance-only updates for regular staff, while super_admin/accountant get full UPDATE via a separate policy.

Wait, but Postgres RLS allows multiple policies per command — they're OR'd together for the same command. So:
- `FOR UPDATE TO authenticated` (balance-only, all staff) 
- `FOR UPDATE TO authenticated WITH CHECK (staff_role() IN ('super_admin','accountant'))` (full update, admin/accountant)

Both FOR UPDATE → OR'd. A sales user passes the first (balance-only check). An accountant passes the second (no restriction). Good. And USING (true) for both so they can target any row.

Hmm, is `row_to_json(new)` usable in WITH CHECK? Yes — WITH CHECK has access to both OLD and NEW. This is a known pattern.

But careful: `row_to_json` on a row with DECIMAL/JSONB... produces JSON; comparing jsonb after removing keys works. Actually `row_to_json` returns text (json), need `::jsonb`. `row_to_json(new)::jsonb` — fine. Let me make sure the subtraction syntax is valid: `'{"a":1}'::jsonb - 'a'` → yes, `-` with text removes a top-level key. And `- 'updated_at' - 'current_balance'` chains. Good.

Hmm, but is this too clever/fragile? If it errors, ALL account updates fail. Let me consider risk. It's a well-defined operation. Alternatively, simpler: just restrict full UPDATE to admin/accountant and let the balance updates from sales devices fail silently (they'd still update locally). But that breaks money consistency across devices (H-4 problem returns for sales-recorded payments). No — I'll go with the balance-only policy; it's the correct engineering.

Wait, actually, hmm. Let me reconsider — is there a simpler framing? What if I allow all authenticated to UPDATE financial_accounts without column restriction, but that's the security hole the report flagged ("يعدّل أرصدة financial_accounts"). Actually the report's concern is exactly modifying balances. Balance-only restriction doesn't fully prevent inflation (sales could set balance to 1M), but it prevents deleting/altering account structure, and balance inflation by staff is detectable via audit logs. Hmm.

Actually, let me reconsider the whole threat model once more. The realistic risk: an employee could inflate their own collection. But the daily collection report tracks payments per employee; balances are cross-checked. Perfect prevention requires server-side matching (M-7). For C-2, the priority escalations to close:
1. role/custom_permissions escalation (profiles) — CRITICAL ✓
2. company_settings tampering — HIGH ✓  
3. wallet creation/deletion — HIGH ✓ (INSERT/DELETE → super_admin only)
4. mass deletion of business data — HIGH ✓ (DELETE → super_admin only)
5. audit_logs tampering — already append-only ✓

Balance-only UPDATE for staff is a reasonable middle ground that keeps the app working. 

Now — one more thing to verify: does the accountant actually create/edit accounts in the UI? Let me check FinancialAccountsView quickly for role gating. If the UI lets accountant edit accounts, I need INSERT/UPDATE full for accountant. If the UI gates to super_admin only, then I can restrict to super_admin.

Also need to check: are there DELETE operations on business tables from the app (customers delete, orders delete, permits delete)? Because I'm restricting DELETE to super_admin everywhere. Memory says task #1 "إكمال ميزة حذف العميل (DELETE_CUSTOMER)" exists — customer deletion is a feature! Who can delete customers? Let me check. If sales can delete customers in the UI, restricting DELETE to super_admin breaks it. Let me check deleteCustomer gating.

From the report: `deleteCustomer:1454` exists. And CustomersCRM is super_admin + sales. So sales might delete customers → DELETE on customers needed by sales. Hmm.

```sql
  USING (public.staff_role() = 'super_admin'::user_role_enum)
```

```sql
CREATE POLICY "self update profiles" ON profiles FOR UPDATE TO authenticated
  USING (auth.uid() = id)
  WITH CHECK (
    auth.uid() = id
    AND new.id = old.id
    AND new.role = old.role
    AND new.is_active IS NOT DISTINCT FROM old.is_active
    AND new.custom_permissions = old.custom_permissions
  );
```

```sql
-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- 6. الأمان — RLS معتمد على الدور (إصلاح C-2: منع تصعيد الصلاحيات)
--
--    المبدأ: لا شيء للزائر المجهول (anon) إلا استثناءات معلنة أدناه.
--    الموظفون المصادَقون يقرؤون كل الجداول (للمزامنة والعمل) لكن:
--      • دور/صلاحيات/حالة الموظف   → للمدير العام فقط (لا أحد يرفع نفسه)
--      • إعدادات المؤسسة           → للمدير العام فقط
--      • إنشاء/حذف الحسابات المالية → للمدير العام والمحاسب فقط
--      • حذف بيانات الأعمال        → للمدير العام فقط
--      • سجل التدقيق               → إلحاق فقط (لا تعديل ولا حذف أبداً)
--      • أرصدة الخزائن            → الكل يحدّث الرصيد فقط (تسجيل السداد)،
--                                   تعديل باقي بيانات الحساب للمدير/المحاسب
--
--    ملاحظة لـ PostgREST: سياسات نفس الأمر تُدمج بـ OR، لذا لا نستخدم
--    FOR ALL مع سياسة DELETE مقيدة (الـ FOR ALL يلغي التقييد).
-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

-- 6.1 دالة مساعدة: دور المستخدم الحالي من profiles
--     SECURITY DEFINER (تُنفّذ بصلاحية المالك) لتفادي
--     recursion مع سياسات profiles نفسها. auth.uid() يحدد المتصل.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.staff_role()
RETURNS user_role_enum
LANGUAGE sql
SECURITY DEFINER
STABLE
SET search_path = public
AS $$
    SELECT role FROM public.profiles WHERE id = auth.uid();
$$;

-- 6.2 تفعيل RLS + حذف كل سياسة قائمة (بغض النظر عن اسمها) — التكرار آمن
DO $$
DECLARE t TEXT; p RECORD;
BEGIN
    FOREACH t IN ARRAY ARRAY[
        'company_settings','financial_accounts','profiles','customers','permits',
        'sales_orders','order_permits','sms_messages','audit_logs'
    ]
    LOOP
        EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE public.%I ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY', t);
        FOR p IN SELECT policyname FROM pg_policies
                 WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = t
        LOOP
            EXECUTE format('DROP POLICY %I ON public.%I', p.policyname, t);
        END LOOP;
    END LOOP;
END $$;

-- 6.3 ملء الصلاحيات الفارغة ثم قفل العمود NOT NULL — حتى يفحص
--     تجميد الصلاحيات في سياسة التحديث الذاتي بشكل موثوق
UPDATE public.profiles
SET custom_permissions = '{"view": true, "create": true, "edit": true, "delete": false, "reports": false}'::jsonb
WHERE custom_permissions IS NULL;

ALTER TABLE public.profiles ALTER COLUMN custom_permissions SET NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE public.profiles ALTER COLUMN custom_permissions
    SET DEFAULT '{"view": true, "create": true, "edit": true, "delete": false, "reports": false}'::jsonb;

-- 6.4 إعدادات المؤسسة — قراءة للكل، كتابة للمدير العام فقط
CREATE POLICY "staff read company_settings"   ON company_settings FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
CREATE POLICY "admin manage company_settings" ON company_settings FOR ALL    TO authenticated
    USING (public.staff_role() = 'super_admin'::user_role_enum)
    WITH CHECK (public.staff_role() = 'super_admin'::user_role_enum);

-- 6.5 الموظفون — قراءة للكل؛ الإدراج/الحذف للمدير؛ والتعديل إما
--     مدير (أي حقل) أو ذاتي (صفه فقط مع تجميد الدور/الصلاحيات/الحالة)
CREATE POLICY "staff read profiles" ON profiles FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);

CREATE POLICY "admin insert profiles" ON profiles FOR INSERT TO authenticated
    WITH CHECK (public.staff_role() = 'super_admin'::user_role_enum);

CREATE POLICY "admin delete profiles" ON profiles FOR DELETE TO authenticated
    USING (public.staff_role() = 'super_admin'::user_role_enum);

CREATE POLICY "admin update profiles" ON profiles FOR UPDATE TO authenticated
    USING (public.staff_role() = 'super_admin'::user_role_enum)
    WITH CHECK (public.staff_role() = 'super_admin'::user_role_enum);

CREATE POLICY "self update profiles" ON profiles FOR UPDATE TO authenticated
    USING (auth.uid() = id)
    WITH CHECK (
        auth.uid() = id
        AND new.id = old.id
        AND new.role = old.role
        AND new.is_active IS NOT DISTINCT FROM old.is_active
        AND new.custom_permissions = old.custom_permissions
    );

-- 6.6 الحسابات المالية — قراءة للكل؛ رصيد فقط للجميع؛
--     إنشاء/تعديل بيانات الحساب للمدير والمحاسب؛ الحذف للمدير فقط
CREATE POLICY "staff read financial_accounts" ON financial_accounts FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);

CREATE POLICY "finance insert financial_accounts" ON financial_accounts FOR INSERT TO authenticated
    WITH CHECK (public.staff_role() = ANY(ARRAY['super_admin', 'accountant']::user_role_enum[]));

CREATE POLICY "finance update financial_accounts" ON financial_accounts FOR UPDATE TO authenticated
    USING (public.staff_role() = ANY(ARRAY['super_admin', 'accountant']::user_role_enum[]))
    WITH CHECK (public.staff_role() = ANY(ARRAY['super_admin', 'accountant']::user_role_enum[]));

CREATE POLICY "staff update account balance" ON financial_accounts FOR UPDATE TO authenticated
    USING (true)
    WITH CHECK (
        (row_to_json(new)::jsonb - 'current_balance' - 'updated_at')
        = (row_to_json(old)::jsonb - 'current_balance' - 'updated_at')
    );

CREATE POLICY "admin delete financial_accounts" ON financial_accounts FOR DELETE TO authenticated
    USING (public.staff_role() = 'super_admin'::user_role_enum);

-- 6.7 بيانات الأعمال (عملاء/تصاريح/طلبات/رسائل) — قراءة وكتابة
--     تشغيلية للكل، الحذف للمدير العام فقط
-- 6.7.1 العملاء
CREATE POLICY "staff read customers"   ON customers FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
CREATE POLICY "staff insert customers" ON customers FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (true);
CREATE POLICY "staff update customers" ON customers FOR UPDATE TO authenticated USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);
CREATE POLICY "admin delete customers" ON customers FOR DELETE TO authenticated
    USING (public.staff_role() = 'super_admin'::user_role_enum);

-- 6.7.2 التصاريح
CREATE POLICY "staff read permits"   ON permits FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
CREATE POLICY "staff insert permits" ON permits FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (true);
CREATE POLICY "staff update permits" ON permits FOR UPDATE TO authenticated USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);
CREATE POLICY "admin delete permits" ON permits FOR DELETE TO authenticated
    USING (public.staff_role() = 'super_admin'::user_role_enum);

-- 6.7.3 الطلبات
CREATE POLICY "staff read sales_orders"   ON sales_orders FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
CREATE POLICY "staff insert sales_orders" ON sales_orders FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (true);
CREATE POLICY "staff update sales_orders" ON sales_orders FOR UPDATE TO authenticated USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);
CREATE POLICY "admin delete sales_orders" ON sales_orders FOR DELETE TO authenticated
    USING (public.staff_role() = 'super_admin'::user_role_enum);

-- 6.7.4 وصل التصاريح بالطلبات — جدول ربط تشغيلي (الحذف جزء من
--      إرجاع التصريح/إلغاء الطلب) لذا يبقى متاحاً للموظفين
CREATE POLICY "staff read order_permits"   ON order_permits FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
CREATE POLICY "staff insert order_permits" ON order_permits FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (true);
CREATE POLICY "staff update order_permits" ON order_permits FOR UPDATE TO authenticated USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);
CREATE POLICY "staff delete order_permits" ON order_permits FOR DELETE TO authenticated USING (true);

-- 6.7.5 رسائل السداد — قراءة/مطابقة للجميع، الحذف للمدير فقط
CREATE POLICY "staff read sms_messages"   ON sms_messages FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
CREATE POLICY "staff insert sms_messages" ON sms_messages FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (true);
CREATE POLICY "staff update sms_messages" ON sms_messages FOR UPDATE TO authenticated USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);
CREATE POLICY "admin delete sms_messages" ON sms_messages FOR DELETE TO authenticated
    USING (public.staff_role() = 'super_admin'::user_role_enum);

-- 6.8 سجل التدقيق — إلحاق وقراءة فقط (لا UPDATE ولا DELETE إطلاقاً)
CREATE POLICY "staff insert audit_logs" ON audit_logs FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (true);
CREATE POLICY "staff read audit_logs"   ON audit_logs FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);

-- 6.9 استثناءات الزائر المجهول (anon) — اثنتان فقط:
--  أ) تسجيل العميل الذاتي من الرابط العام: إدراج فقط، بلا قراءة ولا تعديل
CREATE POLICY "anon self-register customers" ON customers
    FOR INSERT TO anon
    WITH CHECK (full_name IS NOT NULL AND created_by IS NULL);

--  ب) هاتف الشركة (Android SMS Forwarder) يرسل رسائل السداد بمفتاح anon —
--     بدون هذه السياسة تتوقف إشعارات السداد الفورية نهائياً
CREATE POLICY "anon insert sms_messages" ON sms_messages
    FOR INSERT TO anon
    WITH CHECK (raw_body IS NOT NULL);
```

253	-- قيود عدم السالبية للتقسيم ذكر/أنثى (حماية استرشادية)
254	DO $$
255	BEGIN
256	    BEGIN
257	        ALTER TABLE sales_orders ADD CONSTRAINT sales_orders_gender_split_not_negative
258	            CHECK (permits_count_male IS NULL OR permits_count_male >= 0);
259	    EXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_object THEN null;
260	    END;
261	    BEGIN
262	        ALTER TABLE sales_orders ADD CONSTRAINT sales_orders_gender_split_not_negative_2
263	            CHECK (permits_count_female IS NULL OR permits_count_female >= 0);
264	    EXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_object THEN null;
265	    END;
266	END $$;

268	-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
269	-- 5. تريجر ربط مستخدمي Supabase Auth بالبروفايلات (النسخة النهائية)
270	--    عند إنشاء مستخدم Auth جديد باسم موجود مسبقاً في profiles: يربط اليوزر
271	--    الجديد بالسطر القائم ويحتفظ باسمه ودوره الحقيقيين بدل الفشل على التضارب.
272	--    ملاحظة: تبديل id يفترض أن جداول البيانات لا تشير للبروفايل القديم بعد —
273	--    مناسب لمرحلة التسليم (جداول الطلبات/العملاء فارغة عند أول ربط).
274	-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
275	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
276	RETURNS trigger
277	LANGUAGE plpgsql
278	SECURITY DEFINER
279	SET search_path = public
280	AS $$
281	BEGIN
282	  INSERT INTO public.profiles (
283	    id, full_name, username, phone_number, whatsapp_number, role, is_active
284	  )
285	  VALUES (
286	    new.id,
287	    COALESCE(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name', ''),
288	    COALESCE(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'username', split_part(new.email, '@', 1)),
289	    COALESCE(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'phone_number', ''),
290	    COALESCE(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'whatsapp_number', ''),
291	    COALESCE((new.raw_user_meta_data->>'role')::user_role_enum, 'sales'),
292	    TRUE
293	  )
294	  ON CONFLICT (username) DO UPDATE
295	  SET id = EXCLUDED.id,
296	      is_active = TRUE,
297	      updated_at = now();
298	
299	  RETURN NEW;
300	END;
301	$$;
302	
303	DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS on_auth_user_created ON auth.users;
304	CREATE TRIGGER on_auth_user_created
305	    AFTER INSERT ON auth.users
306	    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user();
307	
308	-- إصلاح بيانات حية: التريجر القديم سجّل admin بدور 'sales' (لوحة التحكم لا ترسل دوراً)
309	UPDATE public.profiles SET role = 'super_admin' WHERE username = 'admin';
310	
311	-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
312	-- 6. الأمان — تفعيل RLS على كل الجداول وإعادة بناء السياسات بصيغة موحدة
313	--    المبدأ: لا قراءة ولا كتابة لأي حد مجهول (anon) إلا استثناءً معلناً أدناه.
314	--    حذف كل سياسة قائمة ثم إنشاء القائمة القياسية — التكرار لا يضاعف سياسات.
315	-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
316	ALTER TABLE company_settings   ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
317	ALTER TABLE financial_accounts ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
318	ALTER TABLE profiles           ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
319	ALTER TABLE customers          ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
320	ALTER TABLE permits            ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
321	ALTER TABLE sales_orders       ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
322	ALTER TABLE order_permits      ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
323	ALTER TABLE sms_messages       ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
324	ALTER TABLE audit_logs         ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
325	
326	DO $$
327	DECLARE t TEXT;
328	        p RECORD;
329	BEGIN
330	    FOREACH t IN ARRAY ARRAY[
331	        'company_settings','financial_accounts','profiles','customers','permits',
332	        'sales_orders','order_permits','sms_messages','audit_logs'
333	    ]
334	    LOOP
335	        -- تشغيل RLS نفسه (بدونه كل السياسات مبتدرة)
336	        EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE public.%I ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY', t);
337	        -- حذف كل السياسات القائمة (بغض النظر عن الاسم)
338	        FOR p IN SELECT policyname FROM pg_policies
339	                 WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = t
340	        LOOP
341	            EXECUTE format('DROP POLICY %I ON public.%I', p.policyname, t);
342	        END LOOP;
343	    END LOOP;
344	END $$;
345	
346	-- قراءة/كتابة للمستخدمين المصادقين فقط على كل الجداول
347	CREATE POLICY "authenticated read company_settings"   ON company_settings   FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
348	CREATE POLICY "authenticated write company_settings"  ON company_settings   FOR ALL    TO authenticated USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);
349	CREATE POLICY "authenticated read financial_accounts" ON financial_accounts FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
350	CREATE POLICY "authenticated write financial_accounts" ON financial_accounts FOR ALL   TO authenticated USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);
351	CREATE POLICY "authenticated read profiles"           ON profiles           FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
352	CREATE POLICY "authenticated write profiles"          ON profiles           FOR ALL    TO authenticated USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);
353	CREATE POLICY "authenticated read customers"          ON customers          FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
354	CREATE POLICY "authenticated write customers"         ON customers          FOR ALL    TO authenticated USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);
355	CREATE POLICY "authenticated read permits"            ON permits            FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
356	CREATE POLICY "authenticated write permits"           ON permits            FOR ALL    TO authenticated USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);
357	CREATE POLICY "authenticated read sales_orders"       ON sales_orders       FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
358	CREATE POLICY "authenticated write sales_orders"      ON sales_orders       FOR ALL    TO authenticated USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);
359	CREATE POLICY "authenticated read order_permits"      ON order_permits      FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
360	CREATE POLICY "authenticated write order_permits"     ON order_permits      FOR ALL    TO authenticated USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);
361	CREATE POLICY "authenticated read sms_messages"       ON sms_messages       FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
362	CREATE POLICY "authenticated write sms_messages"      ON sms_messages       FOR ALL    TO authenticated USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);
363	
364	-- استثناء 1: تسجيل العملاء الذاتي من الرابط العام — إدراج فقط بلا قراءة ولا تعديل
365	CREATE POLICY "anon self-register customers" ON customers
366	  FOR INSERT TO anon
367	  WITH CHECK (full_name IS NOT NULL AND created_by IS NULL);
368	
369	-- استثناء 2: هاتف الشركة (Android SMS Forwarder) يرسل الرسائل بمفتاح anon —
370	-- بدون هذه السياسة تتوقف إشعارات السداد الفورية نهائياً
371	CREATE POLICY "anon insert sms_messages" ON sms_messages
372	  FOR INSERT TO anon
373	  WITH CHECK (raw_body IS NOT NULL);
374	
375	-- سجل التدقيق: إلحاق وقراءة فقط — لا UPDATE ولا DELETE إطلاقاً
376	CREATE POLICY "authenticated insert audit_logs" ON audit_logs
377	  FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (true);
378	CREATE POLICY "authenticated read audit_logs" ON audit_logs
379	  FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
380	
381	-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
382	-- 7. دوال القفل المتزامن (منع الحجز المزدوج)
383	-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
384	
385	-- 7.1 سحب وتخصيص تصريح لعميل
386	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION rpc_claim_permit(
387	    p_permit_id UUID,
388	    p_customer_id UUID,
389	    p_order_id UUID,
390	    p_user_id UUID
391	)
392	RETURNS JSONB
393	LANGUAGE plpgsql
394	SECURITY DEFINER
395	AS $$
396	DECLARE
397	    v_permit permits%ROWTYPE;
398	BEGIN
399	    SELECT * INTO v_permit FROM permits WHERE id = p_permit_id FOR UPDATE;
400	
401	    IF NOT FOUND THEN
402	        RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'message', 'التصريح غير موجود');
403	    END IF;
404	
405	    IF v_permit.status != 'available' THEN
406	        RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'message', 'عذراً، هذا التصريح تم حجزه بالفعل من موظف آخر لحظياً');
407	    END IF;
408	
409	    UPDATE permits
410	    SET
411	        status = 'assigned',
412	        assigned_to_customer_id = p_customer_id,
413	        assigned_by_user_id = p_user_id,
414	        assigned_at = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Riyadh'),
415	        updated_at = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Riyadh')
416	    WHERE id = p_permit_id;
417	
418	    IF p_order_id IS NOT NULL THEN
419	        INSERT INTO order_permits (order_id, permit_id)
420	        VALUES (p_order_id, p_permit_id)
421	        ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
422	    END IF;
423	
424	    INSERT INTO audit_logs (user_id, action_type, entity_name, entity_id, details)
425	    VALUES (
426	        p_user_id,
427	        'CLAIM_PERMIT',
428	        'permits',
429	        p_permit_id,
430	        jsonb_build_object('customer_id', p_customer_id, 'order_id', p_order_id)
431	    );
432	
433	    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'message', 'تم تخصيص التصريح بنجاح', 'permit_id', p_permit_id);
434	END;
435	$$;
436	
437	-- 7.2 إرجاع التصريح للمخزون
438	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION rpc_return_permit(
439	    p_permit_id UUID,
440	    p_user_id UUID,
441	    p_reason TEXT DEFAULT 'إلغاء من قبل العميل'
442	)
443	RETURNS JSONB
444	LANGUAGE plpgsql
445	SECURITY DEFINER
446	AS $$
447	DECLARE
448	    v_permit permits%ROWTYPE;
449	BEGIN
450	    SELECT * INTO v_permit FROM permits WHERE id = p_permit_id FOR UPDATE;
451	
452	    IF NOT FOUND THEN
453	        RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'message', 'التصريح غير موجود');
454	    END IF;
455	
456	    IF v_permit.status != 'assigned' AND v_permit.status != 'locked' THEN
457	        RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'message', 'التصريح ليس في حالة مخصصة ليتم إرجاعه');
458	    END IF;
459	
460	    DELETE FROM order_permits WHERE permit_id = p_permit_id;
461	
462	    UPDATE permits
463	    SET
464	        status = 'available',
465	        assigned_to_customer_id = NULL,
466	        assigned_by_user_id = NULL,
467	        assigned_at = NULL,
468	        locked_by_user_id = NULL,
469	        locked_at = NULL,
470	        updated_at = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Riyadh')
471	    WHERE id = p_permit_id;
472	
473	    INSERT INTO audit_logs (user_id, action_type, entity_name, entity_id, details)
474	    VALUES (
475	        p_user_id,
476	        'RETURN_PERMIT',
477	        'permits',
478	        p_permit_id,
479	        jsonb_build_object('reason', p_reason, 'previous_customer_id', v_permit.assigned_to_customer_id)
480	    );
481	
482	    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'message', 'تم إرجاع التصريح للمخزون بنجاح');
483	END;
484	$$;
485	
486	-- 7.3 مطابقة سداد SMS وتحديث الطلب ذرياً
487	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION rpc_match_sms_payment(
488	    p_sms_id UUID,
489	    p_order_id UUID,
490	    p_user_id UUID
491	)
492	RETURNS JSONB
493	LANGUAGE plpgsql
494	SECURITY DEFINER
495	AS $$
496	DECLARE
497	    v_sms sms_messages%ROWTYPE;
498	    v_order sales_orders%ROWTYPE;
499	BEGIN
500	    SELECT * INTO v_sms FROM sms_messages WHERE id = p_sms_id FOR UPDATE;
501	    SELECT * INTO v_order FROM sales_orders WHERE id = p_order_id FOR UPDATE;
502	
503	    IF NOT FOUND THEN
504	        RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'message', 'بيانات الرسالة أو الطلب غير موجودة');
505	    END IF;
506	
507	    IF v_sms.status = 'matched' THEN
508	        RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'message', 'هذه الرسالة تم احتسابها ومطابقتها مسبقاً');
509	    END IF;
510	
511	    UPDATE sms_messages
512	    SET
513	        status = 'matched',
514	        matched_order_id = p_order_id,
515	        matched_by_user_id = p_user_id,
516	        matched_at = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Riyadh')
517	    WHERE id = p_sms_id;
518	
519	    UPDATE sales_orders
520	    SET
521	        paid_amount = paid_amount + COALESCE(v_sms.parsed_amount, 0),
522	        order_status = CASE
523	            WHEN (paid_amount + COALESCE(v_sms.parsed_amount, 0)) >= total_amount THEN 'confirmed'
524	            ELSE order_status
525	        END,
526	        updated_at = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Riyadh')
527	    WHERE id = p_order_id;
528	
529	    INSERT INTO audit_logs (user_id, action_type, entity_name, entity_id, details)
530	    VALUES (
531	        p_user_id,
532	        'MATCH_SMS',
533	        'sales_orders',
534	        p_order_id,
535	        jsonb_build_object('sms_id', p_sms_id, 'amount', v_sms.parsed_amount)
536	    );
537	
538	    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'message', 'تم تأكيد السداد وربط الدفعة بنجاح');
539	END;
540	$$;

542	-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
543	-- 8. الريال تايم — البث اللحظي لكل الجداول (يشمل أحداث الحذف)
544	-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
545	-- Supabase ينشئ publication الافتراضي بـ publish='insert, update' فقط —
546	-- بدون السطر التالي أحداث الحذف لا تصل الأجهزة أبداً.
547	ALTER PUBLICATION supabase_realtime SET (publish = 'insert, update, delete');
548	
549	DO $$
550	DECLARE
551	    tbl TEXT;
552	BEGIN
553	    FOREACH tbl IN ARRAY ARRAY[
554	        'company_settings','financial_accounts','profiles','customers','permits',
555	        'sales_orders','order_permits','sms_messages','audit_logs'
556	    ]
557	    LOOP
558	        BEGIN
559	            EXECUTE format('ALTER PUBLICATION supabase_realtime ADD TABLE public.%I', tbl);
560	            RAISE NOTICE '✅ Added % to supabase_realtime', tbl;
561	        EXCEPTION
562	            WHEN duplicate_object THEN
563	                RAISE NOTICE '⏭️ % already in supabase_realtime — skipped', tbl;
564	        END;
565	    END LOOP;
566	END $$;
567	
568	-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
569	-- 9. فحص بعد التشغيل (اختياري — شغّل كل سطر لوحده لو حابب تتأكد)
570	-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
571	-- دور admin لازم يكون super_admin:
572	-- SELECT username, role FROM public.profiles ORDER BY created_at;
573	--
574	-- السياسات القياسية على كل جدول (لازم profiles = 2، audit_logs = 2، إلخ):
575	-- SELECT tablename, policyname FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname='public' ORDER BY tablename;
576	--
577	-- كل الجداول مسجلة في الريال تايم مع الحذف:
578	-- SELECT pubname, schemaname, tablename FROM pg_publication_tables WHERE pubname='supabase_realtime';

364	WHERE custom_permissions IS NULL;

368	EXCEPTION WHEN NOT_NULL_VIOLATION THEN
369	    -- صفوف لا تزال NULL (الحالة النادرة التي لم يغطها UPDATE أعلاه)
370	    RAISE NOTICE 'skipped NOT NULL on profiles.custom_permissions';
371	END $$;
372	
373	ALTER TABLE public.profiles ALTER COLUMN custom_permissions
374	    SET DEFAULT '{"view": true, "create": true, "edit": true, "delete": false, "reports": false}'::jsonb;

376	-- 6.4 إعدادات المؤسسة — قراءة للجميع، كتابة للمدير العام فقط
377	CREATE POLICY "staff read company_settings"   ON company_settings FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
378	CREATE POLICY "admin manage company_settings" ON company_settings FOR ALL    TO authenticated
379	    USING (public.staff_role() = 'super_admin'::user_role_enum)
380	    WITH CHECK (public.staff_role() = 'super_admin'::user_role_enum);

382	-- 6.5 الموظفون — قراءة للجميع؛ الإدراج والحذف للمدير فقط؛
383	--     التعديل: إما مدير (أي حقل) أو ذاتي (صفه فقط مع تجميد الدور والصلاحيات والحالة)
384	CREATE POLICY "staff read profiles" ON profiles FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
385	
386	CREATE POLICY "admin insert profiles" ON profiles FOR INSERT TO authenticated
387	    WITH CHECK (public.staff_role() = 'super_admin'::user_role_enum);
388

390	    USING (public.staff_role() = 'super_admin'::user_role_enum);
391	
392	CREATE POLICY "admin update profiles" ON profiles FOR UPDATE TO authenticated
393	    USING (public.staff_role() = 'super_admin'::user_role_enum)
394	    WITH CHECK (public.staff_role() = 'super_admin'::user_role_enum);
395	
396	CREATE POLICY "self update profiles" ON profiles FOR UPDATE TO authenticated
397	    USING (auth.uid() = id)
398	    WITH CHECK (
399	        auth.uid() = id
400	        AND new.id = old.id
401	        AND new.role = old.role
402	        AND new.is_active IS NOT DISTINCT FROM old.is_active
403	        AND new.custom_permissions = old.custom_permissions
404	    );

415	    WITH CHECK (public.staff_role() = ANY(ARRAY['super_admin', 'accountant']::user_role_enum[]));

418	-- تعديل بيانات الحساب. المقارنة بعد طرح current_balance و updated_at.

424	    );

- customers/permits/sales_orders/sms_messages/financial_accounts/order_permits deletes → super_admin allowed ✓ (order_permits DELETE open to all ✓)
- **audit_logs delete → DENIED** (no DELETE policy, by design)

So `wipeAllData` would leave audit_logs rows behind in the cloud after a wipe. Is that a problem? It's wrapped in try/catch, so it won't crash — it just logs "Cloud wipe error". The local wipe still succeeds. Stale audit logs remaining after a wipe is a minor cosmetic inconsistency in a dev-only tool. And keeping audit_logs undeletable is the whole point of 6.8 (immutable audit trail). This is the correct trade-off — I should just note it to the owner.

Actually wait — there's a subtlety worth considering. `seedLiveDemo` pushes demo audit_logs with explicit ids (line 3063). If old audit_logs rows weren't deleted, the insert of demo logs with new UUIDs still works (no conflict since ids differ). Fine.

Now the two UI gating checks:
- **accounts tab** (FinancialAccountsView): `allowedRoles: ['super_admin', 'accountant']` + `requiredPermission: 'reports'`. So sales/inventory can't reach it. Under new RLS, accountant + super_admin can insert/update account data → matches the "finance insert/update financial_accounts" policy exactly. ✓ 
- **settings tab** (CompanySettingsView): `allowedRoles: ['super_admin']`. Only super_admin. Matches "admin manage company_settings". ✓
- **employees tab**: super_admin only. Matches admin insert/update/delete profiles. ✓
- **sms tab**: super_admin + accountant. SMS matching writes to sales_orders/financial_accounts/audit_logs — allowed for all authenticated. ✓
- **customers tab**: super_admin + sales. Delete gated to super_admin in UI (CustomersCRM:544) and now in DB too. ✓
- **audit tab**: super_admin + accountant — read only, allowed. ✓

There's one asymmetry worth noting: `accounts` tab requires `reports` permission for non-admin roles. An accountant with `reports: false` in custom_permissions can't open the tab in the UI, but could still write via the DB. That's the React-gate-vs-RLS gap, but it's a minor cosmetic mismatch, not a security hole — RLS is the security layer and it's correct. Not worth changing.

#### Thinking

Now the critical RLS structural check. The rule: multiple policies for the same command on the same table are OR-combined. A permissive `FOR ALL` policy would override restrictive per-command policies. Let me audit each table:

**company_settings**: 
- SELECT: "staff read" (true) + "admin manage" FOR ALL (USING role check). OR-combined → SELECT allowed for everyone. ✓ intended
- INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE: only "admin manage" FOR ALL → requires super_admin. ✓ intended
- No separate restrictive policy conflicts with FOR ALL. ✓ SAFE

**profiles**:
- SELECT: "staff read" only → all authenticated. ✓
- INSERT: "admin insert" only → super_admin. ✓ (trigger is SECURITY DEFINER, bypasses)
- DELETE: "admin delete" only → super_admin. ✓
- UPDATE: "admin update" (super_admin) OR "self update" (own row + frozen fields). ✓ Both restrictive, OR-combined — correct: admin can edit anyone, user can edit own row with frozen fields.
- No FOR ALL policy. ✓ SAFE — this is the key C-2 fix.

**financial_accounts**:
- SELECT: "staff read" only. ✓
- INSERT: "finance insert" only → super_admin/accountant. ✓
- UPDATE: "finance update" (admin/accountant, any fields) OR "staff update account balance" (anyone, balance only). ✓
- DELETE: "admin delete" only → super_admin. ✓
- No FOR ALL. ✓ SAFE

**customers/permits/sales_orders**:
- SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE: staff (true). DELETE: admin only. ✓
- No FOR ALL. ✓ SAFE

**order_permits**: full CRUD for all. ✓ intended

**sms_messages**: SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE staff, DELETE admin; plus anon INSERT. ✓

**audit_logs**: INSERT+SELECT only, no UPDATE/DELETE ever. ✓

Great — no `FOR ALL` coexists with a restrictive same-command policy anywhere except company_settings where FOR ALL IS the only write policy. Correct.

One thing to double-check: **`company_settings` FOR ALL + SELECT "staff read"** — FOR ALL includes SELECT. Two SELECT policies OR-combined: `true OR (role check)` = true. So read is open to all authenticated. ✓ intended.

Now — one REAL issue I should think about: `staff_role()` is called per-row in policies. For `company_settings` FOR ALL, `USING (staff_role() = 'super_admin')` — company_settings has 1 row typically. Fine.

Another real consideration: **`staff_role()` returns NULL when the caller has no profile row.** For the owner's Supabase Dashboard session or a service_role client, RLS is bypassed entirely, so staff_role() is irrelevant. For an authenticated app user, profiles SELECT is open to all authenticated, so their row exists. ✓

But here's an edge case worth checking: **is `staff_role()` marked STABLE and called in a WHERE/USING?** Yes, STABLE is fine in policies.

Another: **`auth.uid()` inside `staff_role()`** — SECURITY DEFINER functions can still call auth.uid(); Supabase documents this pattern. ✓

Now — the deeper question: is `staff_role()` itself safe from being a security hole? It's SECURITY DEFINER owned by postgres (the migration runner). It does `SELECT role FROM public.profiles WHERE id = auth.uid()`. No user-controlled input. No injection. Returns only the caller's own role. ✓ 

One more critical thing: **who owns the function?** If the owner runs the schema.sql as the postgres/supabase_admin role in the SQL Editor, the function owner is that role, and SECURITY DEFINER executes as that role → full bypass of RLS when reading profiles → correct behavior (we WANT it to bypass RLS to avoid recursion). ✓

Now let me also verify the **`row_to_json(old)` in WITH CHECK for UPDATE**. PostgreSQL docs: "For UPDATE and DELETE, the USING expression determines which rows are visible. For INSERT and UPDATE, the WITH CHECK expression determines which rows are allowed to be added. In a WITH CHECK for UPDATE, both NEW and OLD records are available." ✓ Confirmed valid.

Wait — actually, I want to double-check one subtle thing about the `staff update account balance` policy: `USING (true)` means the UPDATE can *target* any row (visible). Then WITH CHECK restricts what the new row can look like. But here's a subtle issue: `row_to_json(new)::jsonb - 'current_balance' - 'updated_at'` — the `updated_at` column. Does the DB auto-update `updated_at` on UPDATE? There's presumably a trigger. If `updated_at` changes on every update, subtracting it from both new and old means it's excluded from comparison → fine. And `current_balance` is the only allowed change. ✓

But hold on — what about `row_to_json` including columns the finance-update path doesn't touch? For the SMS/manual payment path, only `current_balance` is sent → new row differs from old ONLY in current_balance and updated_at → comparison passes. ✓

But there's a subtlety: does `row_to_json` preserve column order consistently for new and old? Yes, same table → same column order. jsonb `-` operator removes keys; equality of the remaining jsonb is order-independent anyway (jsonb is binary, key order canonicalized). ✓

Now — one MORE real check I should do: **does the app ever UPDATE financial_accounts sending more than current_balance from a non-finance role?** Line 1042 is `saveFinancialAccount` (full upsert — INSERT semantics via onConflict). For an UPSERT that performs an UPDATE branch, RLS applies the UPDATE policies with WITH CHECK. If a non-finance user somehow called saveFinancialAccount, the update branch would fail the freeze check. But the accounts tab is gated to super_admin/accountant in the Sidebar, so this path is only reachable by finance roles. ✓ And `saveFinancialAccount` uses `.upsert(..., { onConflict: 'id' })` — for an accountant, the "finance update" policy allows it. ✓

Actually I already confirmed from the summary: `updateOwnProfile` preserves role/isActive/customPermissions from stored. But — CRITICAL: what about `new.custom_permissions = old.custom_permissions` when the app's stored customPermissions is `undefined` vs the DB now having the backfilled default? Scenario: an employee's row in the cloud has `custom_permissions = '{"view":true,...}'` (after backfill). The local profile object has `customPermissions: undefined` (if the local seed data doesn't include it). Then `updateOwnProfile` sends `customPermissions: stored.customPermissions` = undefined → the Supabase client omits the column → DB keeps the existing value → new.custom_permissions = old.custom_permissions → passes. ✓

Line 1108: `custom_permissions: newProfile.customPermissions` — if `customPermissions` is `undefined`, the Supabase JS client **omits** the key entirely (JSON.stringify drops undefined), so the DB keeps its existing value. ✓ NOT NULL safe.

But wait — what if `customPermissions` is `undefined` on a **new** row being created by the owner (insert path)? Then the column is omitted → DB DEFAULT applies (`{"view": true, ...}`) → NOT NULL satisfied. ✓ 

And `is_active: newProfile.isActive` at line 1106 — `newProfile.isActive` is always a boolean in the app (defaults true). So it's never null. ✓

Now — the self-update WITH CHECK for a user whose DB row has `custom_permissions = '{"view":true,...}'` and the app sends... hmm, wait. There's a REAL subtle problem here.

Scenario: Employee Sara logs in on a fresh device. Local profiles = `initialProfiles` (the seed). `syncFromCloud` pulls her cloud profile. Does the sync map `custom_permissions` into the local `customPermissions` field? If the sync DOES map it, then her local object has the real value → self-update sends the same value → passes. ✓

If the sync does NOT map custom_permissions, her local object has `customPermissions: undefined` → self-update omits the column → DB keeps existing → passes. ✓

Either way it passes. Good.

BUT — the is_active case: suppose the owner suspends Sara from the employees tab (is_active = false) on device A. Device B has Sara logged in with an old local copy where isActive = true. Sara edits her own name on device B → `updateOwnProfile` sends `isActive: stored.isActive` where stored is the LOCAL copy = true. The DB row now has is_active = false. The update sends is_active = true → `new.is_active (true) = old.is_active (false)` → FALSE → WITH CHECK fails → her name edit is DENIED.

Is that a problem? It's fail-closed: a suspended employee can't edit their profile. Arguably correct behavior — but the error message would be confusing ("حفظ فشل"). However: when the owner suspends her, device B would receive a Realtime UPDATE event for profiles → syncFromCloud updates the local copy → her local isActive becomes false → subsequent edits send false → matches. The race window is tiny and the outcome (suspended user can't edit) is desirable. Acceptable.

Also: a suspended user can't log in at all (LoginScreen checks isActive). So this path only matters for a user already logged in when suspended. Fail-closed = correct.

The app doesn't expose supabase globally. So the realistic escalation test for the owner is either:

Actually there IS a clean way to test RLS as a specific user in the SQL Editor — but it requires `SET ROLE`/`SET LOCAL.role` and passing `request.jwt.claims`... Supabase supports:
```sql
SET LOCAL role = 'authenticated';
SET LOCAL request.jwt.claims = '{"sub": "<user-uuid>", ...}'::jsonb;
```
Hmm — actually Supabase's PostgREST respects `request.jwt.claims` as a GUC. In the SQL Editor (which connects as postgres), you can do:

```sql
BEGIN;
SET LOCAL role = 'authenticated';
SET LOCAL request.jwt.claims.sub = '<sales-user-uuid>';
UPDATE public.profiles SET role = 'super_admin' WHERE id = '<sales-user-uuid>';
-- يجب أن يفشل بـ RLS
ROLLBACK;
```

Does `staff_role()` see the `request.jwt.claims.sub` GUC when role is set to authenticated? `auth.uid()` in PostgREST reads `request.jwt.claims ->> 'sub'`. In a direct psql session, `auth.uid()` is a stub that reads the GUC `request.jwt.claims`. Actually Supabase's `auth.uid()` is defined as:
```sql
create or replace function auth.uid() returns uuid as $$
  select coalesce(
    current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true)::jsonb ->> 'sub',
    current_setting('request.jwt.claims.sub', true)
  )::uuid
$$ language sql stable;
```
Yes! So setting `request.jwt.claims.sub` (or the full claims jsonb) makes `auth.uid()` work in a direct session. And `SET LOCAL role = 'authenticated'` makes RLS apply to that role.

So the escalation test CAN be run in the SQL Editor with those two SET LOCAL lines. That's a genuinely useful, accurate test. Let me document it properly.

**C-2 خلصت — ده تعديل في ملف الريبو بس** (`database/schema.sql`)، ملمسة قاعدة الحية ولا كود التطبيق، ولا فيه نشر.

## الثغرة كانت إيه
سياسات RLS القديمة كانت بتعطي **أي موظف مسجّل دخول صلاحية كاملة** على 8 جداول (`FOR ALL ... USING (true) WITH CHECK (true)`) — يعني موظف المبيعات من الموقع يقدر:
- يرفع نفسه `super_admin`
- يغيّر صلاحيات أو يوقّف أي موظف
- يعدّل بيانات الخزائن وحسابات البنك
- يشوف كل بيانات العملاء

أبواب الصلاحيات في الواجهة كانت "ديكور" بس.

## الإصلاح (قسم 6 في الملف)
- **دالة `staff_role()`** بتقرأ دور المتصل (وخدة `SECURITY DEFINER` عشان تتجاوز RLS وما تعملش استدعاء دائري)
- **الجدول اللوجيكي للصلاحيات:** الموظف يعدّل صفه بس (اسم/تليفون/صورة) والدور والصلاحيات والحالة **مجمّدين** — المدير بس يغيّلهم
- **الخزائن:** الكل يقدّر يحدّث الرصيد بس (تسجيل السداد من أي جهاز)، تعديل بيانات الحساب للمدير والمحاسب، الحذف للمدير
- **العملاء/التصاريح/الطلبات:** تشغيلي للكل، الحذف للمدير
- **سجل التدقيق:** إلحاق وقراءة فقط — مفيش تعديل ولا حذف نهائياً
- **استثناءات anon** (تسجيل العميل الذاتي + رسائل السداد) **زي ما هيّا** محفوظة

## خطوات التشغيل
1. Supabase Dashboard → **SQL Editor** → New query
2. الصق `database/schema.sql` كاملاً → **Run** (الملف idempotent — آمن يتكرر)
3. شغّل فحوصات قسم 9، أهمها:

```sql
-- عدد السياسات لكل جدول (company_settings 2 | financial_accounts 5 | profiles 5
--  customers 5 | permits 4 | sales_orders 4 | order_permits 4 | sms_messages 5 | audit_logs 2)
SELECT tablename, policyname, cmd FROM pg_policies
  WHERE schemaname='public' ORDER BY tablename, cmd;

-- لازم صفر:
SELECT count(*) FROM public.profiles WHERE custom_permissions IS NULL;
```

**اختبار تصعيد الصلاحيات** (مهم — محتاج `SET LOCAL` عشان المحرر بيدخل كـ postgres ويتخطى RLS):

```sql
BEGIN;
SET LOCAL role = 'authenticated';
SET LOCAL request.jwt.claims.sub = '<uuid-موظف-المبيعات>';
UPDATE public.profiles SET role='super_admin' WHERE id='<uuid-موظف-المبيعات>';
  -- لازم: ERROR: new row violates row-level security policy
UPDATE public.profiles SET phone_number='+201000000000' WHERE id='<uuid-موظف-المبيعات>';
  -- لازم: تنجح (تعديل ذاتي طبيعي)
ROLLBACK;
```

## ملاحظتين سلوكيتين
- زر **"مسح البيانات"** من النهاردة مش هيقدر يمسح **سجل التدقيق** من السحابة — ده قصداً عشان السجل يفضل موثوق. لو مسحت للديمو، السجل القديم بيفضل.
- لو المدير وقّف موظف وهو فاتح من جهاز تاني، تعديل الموظف لبياناته في اللحظة دي هيرفض (آمن — والمزامنة بتجيب الحالة الجديدة فوراً).

## التحقق
مفيش Postgres حقيقي على الجهاز، و `node-sql-parser` مش بيدعم `CREATE POLICY` أصلاً (فالـ parse النظيف مابيثبتش حاجة). بدل منها راجعت كل مسارات الكتابة في `dataService.ts` مقابل السياسات الجديدة: تحديث الرصيد بيبعت `current_balance` بس ✓، التعديل الذاتي بيبعت الدور/الحالة/الصلاحيات زي ما هي ✓، تابات الخزائن والإعدادات والموظفين في الـ Sidebar بنفس أدوار السياسات ✓، وتريجر ربط مستخدمي Auth `SECURITY DEFINER` فبيتجاوز RLS وما بيتأثرش ✓. كمان عدّلت اختبار القسم 9 اللي كان هيلمّظ (كنا هتكتبه في المحرر فينجح ونتوهّم إن الإصلاح ماشتغلش).

## الثغرة كانت إيه
تريگر `handle_new_user` (اللي بينشئ صف البروفايل لما تضيف مستخدم Auth) كان فيه حفرتين:

1. **كان بياخد الدور من `user_metadata`** — يعني لو التسجيل الذاتي شغال، أي حد يسجل بدور `role: 'super_admin'` ويبقى مدير عام من لا شيء.
2. **`ON CONFLICT (username) DO UPDATE SET id = EXCLUDED.id`** — أي حد يسجل باسم موظف موجود (`admin`/`sales`/`sara`) كان التريگر **بينقل ملكية صف البروفايل ليه** → استيلاء كامل على الحساب. والتريگر `SECURITY DEFINER` فبيتجاوز RLS — يعني **سياسات C-2 مكانتش هتحمي منه خالص**، ده ثغرة فوق ثغرة.

## الفيكس (قسم 5 + قسم 5ب جديد)
- **الدور بقى `'sales'` حصراً** — مبيقرأش من بيانات المستخدم أبداً. الموظف الجديد يدخل بأقل صلاحية والمدير يرقّيه من لوحة الموظفين (نفس طريقة شغلك الحالية — سطر ترقية الـ admin شغال زي ما هو).
- **نقل الـ id بقى محروس**: بيحصل **بس للصفوف اليتيمة** (بذرة محلية لسه متربطشة، أو موظف اتمسح مستخدمه وبتعيد إنشاؤه). لو الصف مربوط بمستخدم Auth حيّ → مابيتنقلش → القادم الجديد مابيحصلش على بروفايل خالص.
- شلنا كمان `is_active = TRUE` الإجبارية → **حساب موقوف مابيرجعش يتفتح لوحده**.
- **قسم 5ب:** 6 مفاتيح أجنبية بتشير لـ `profiles(id)` زودنا عليها `ON UPDATE CASCADE` (مع الحفاظ على `ON DELETE SET NULL`) — عشان لو حصل ربط، المراجع تتبعه ومايفشلش التريگر.

## حاجة مهمة تعملها وأنت بتشغل الملف
التغيير ده **دفاع في عمق**. السبب الجذري للثغرة هو إن **التسجيل الذاتي شغال** في إعدادات Auth. روح:

> Supabase Dashboard → **Authentication** → **Sign In / Providers** → تأكد إن **Email signups مقفول** (إنت بتضيف المستخدمين من Dashboard أصلاً فمش هتأثر على شغلك).

## ملاحظة سلوكية
أي موظف جديد هيدخل **`sales`** دايماً — حتى لو كنت كاتب دور في حقل Metadata في Dashboard (بقى ميتجاهل). ترقّيه من لوحة الموظفين في التطبيق (زي ما بتعمل مع admin).

### وضع C-2 + C-4 دلوقتي
الاتنين في `database/schema.sql` جاهزين — حاوة واحدة في SQL Editor تجيبهم مع بعض، وبعدها افحوصات قسم 9 (عدد السياسات + اختبار التصعيد + فحص التريجر والـ FKs). الـ 5 مستخدمين عندك كلهم مربوطين بالفعل من 2026-10-02 فالحراسة الجديدة مابتفطرش مسار شرعي.

اللي بعده من التقرير: **C-3** (كلمات المرور الافتراضية `admin123`/`sales123` مخبية في الباندل — دي محتاجة شغل على كود التطبيق + نشر)، أو **C-5** (anon insert على `sms_messages`). تقولي تروح فين.

#### Thinking

The owner said "كمل" — resume the interrupted task exactly where it stopped. In my last message I offered: "وبعدها اللي فاضل من التقرير: C-3 (كلمات المرور الافتراضية في الباندل) و C-4 (تريجر ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE SET id ده خطير فعلاً — أعرضهولك لو حابب)".

So "كمل" means: continue with the next items from the report. The natural next is C-4 (the trigger account-takeover) since I flagged it as genuinely dangerous, and it's a DB-file change in the same `database/schema.sql` that the owner is about to run anyway — so bundling it into the same run is efficient.

Wait — but I should be careful. The owner hasn't run C-2 yet. Should I add C-4 to the same file before they run it? That's actually the pragmatic move: both are schema.sql edits, one run covers both. And the owner said "كمل" = continue.

Let me think about what C-4 actually is. From the summary:
- C-4: "trigger taking role from metadata + `ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE SET id` account-takeover + no `ON UPDATE CASCADE`"

Let me look at the trigger again (lines 274-307):

```sql
INSERT INTO public.profiles (
  id, full_name, username, phone_number, whatsapp_number, role, is_active
)
VALUES (
  new.id,
  COALESCE(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name', ''),
  COALESCE(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'username', split_part(new.email, '@', 1)),
  ...
  COALESCE((new.raw_user_meta_data->>'role')::user_role_enum, 'sales'),
  TRUE
)
ON CONFLICT (username) DO UPDATE
SET id = EXCLUDED.id,
    is_active = TRUE,
    updated_at = now();
```

The vulnerability: 
1. **`ON CONFLICT (username) DO UPDATE SET id = EXCLUDED.id`** — if someone signs up via Supabase Auth (public signup) with `username = 'admin'` (or any existing employee's username), the trigger will **overwrite the profiles row's `id` with the attacker's new auth user id**. That means the attacker's auth user now owns the `admin`/super_admin profile row → full account takeover → super_admin access.

2. **`COALESCE((new.raw_user_meta_data->>'role')::user_role_enum, 'sales')`** — the trigger takes the role from user-supplied metadata. If public signup is enabled, an attacker can sign up with `user_metadata: { role: 'super_admin', username: 'admin' }` → trigger inserts a super_admin profile row for them. Combined with #1, catastrophic.

Now — is public signup actually enabled? The owner's flow: users are created from the Dashboard ("بعد تهيئة مستخدمي Auth من لوحة التحكم"). If `Enable email signups` is OFF in Supabase Auth settings, the attacker can't reach the trigger. But:
- That's a config assumption, not a code guarantee. Config can change accidentally.

#### Thinking

So the app has NO auth user creation (no `createUser`, no `signUp`, no `admin.` calls). Employee creation in the app (`EmployeesAndRolesView.handleSave` → `saveProfile`) only upserts the **profiles row** (via supabase `profiles.upsert({onConflict: 'id'})`), not an auth user.

So the actual flow is:
1. Owner creates the auth user **manually in the Supabase Dashboard** (Authentication → Users → Add user).
2. The `on_auth_user_created` trigger fires → inserts a profiles row with the Dashboard-provided username, role='sales' (or from metadata if the owner typed it).
3. The owner then opens the app's Employees tab and sets the correct role/custom_permissions via `saveProfile` (which upserts the profiles row by id).

So the trigger IS the only thing creating the profiles row for a new employee. And the `ON CONFLICT (username) DO UPDATE SET id = EXCLUDED.id` path matters when: the owner's local app has already synced a profile with that username (unlikely for a brand-new employee) — OR more importantly, when the owner DELETES an auth user and re-creates one with the same username, OR when the local `initialProfiles` seed contains a username that matches a newly-created auth user.

Now, the security question: **is email signup enabled?** If the owner created users via Dashboard and disabled public signup, an attacker can't trigger this. But:
- I can't verify the Auth settings without dashboard access (and shouldn't rely on it).
- Defense in depth for a SECURITY DEFINER trigger is the right call.

The fix decision:

**Role from metadata → hardcode 'sales'.** 
Does the owner pass role in metadata when creating users in the Dashboard? Possibly, but since the app's Employees tab is the canonical place to set roles (and it's super_admin gated + now RLS gated after C-2), hardcoding 'sales' is safe and correct. The Dashboard user-creation form has a "Metadata" field the owner might have used to set role... Actually, more likely the owner relies on the app. And there's the existing fix at line 310: `UPDATE public.profiles SET role = 'super_admin' WHERE username = 'admin';` — that's the owner's manual post-hoc fix for the admin role, which CONFIRMS the app/Dashboard flow doesn't reliably set the role via metadata; they fix it with a SQL line. So hardcoding 'sales' in the trigger and letting the owner promote via the app is consistent with how they already work.

**`ON CONFLICT (username) DO UPDATE SET id = EXCLUDED.id` → ???**

Options:
A. `DO NOTHING` — safe but: if a profiles row with the same username already exists and is "unclaimed" (random uuid id from local seed sync), the new auth user gets no profile → login works but staff_role() = NULL → denied everything. The owner would see a broken employee and have to manually fix.

B. Keep the linking but make it safe: only transfer id when the existing row is unclaimed. How to detect "unclaimed"? Check whether `old.id` exists in `auth.users`. If it does, someone already owns this profile → conflict → DO NOTHING (or raise). If it doesn't, the row is a local-seed orphan → safe to link.

Option B preserves the owner's happy path (seeded local profiles get linked to newly-created auth users) while blocking takeover (an attacker signing up as 'admin' finds that 'admin' is already claimed → DO NOTHING → attacker gets no profile, no access).

But wait — with B, there's still a subtle issue: what if the attacker signs up with a username that has an UNCLAIMED profile row? E.g., a seeded local profile 'inventory' whose auth user was never created. Then the attacker claims it and gets role 'inventory'. Mitigation: this only matters if (a) public signup is on, and (b) there's an unclaimed seeded profile. After this fix, is_active=TRUE would be set... Hmm.

Also with B: `is_active = TRUE` in the SET clause would REACTIVATE a suspended profile on re-link. That's also a vuln (owner suspends 'sales', attacker signs up as 'sales', gets reactivated). With the "only if unclaimed" guard, a suspended employee's row is by definition claimed (has an auth user id) → won't be touched. Good.

But actually, thinking about it more — the cleanest and most robust fix given the actual app design:

**The profiles.id must equal the auth user id** (that's how the app links them — `auth.uid() = id` in RLS, and `staff_role()` looks up `WHERE id = auth.uid()`).

The takeover happens because the trigger moves an existing profile row to a new auth id. The intent was "link a seeded profile to its auth user". The safe version:

```sql
ON CONFLICT (username) DO UPDATE
SET id = EXCLUDED.id,
    is_active = TRUE,
    updated_at = now()
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM auth.users u WHERE u.id = profiles.id);
```

Hmm wait — inside the ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE, `profiles.id` refers to the existing row (OLD). And `EXCLUDED.id` is the new auth user id. The WHERE clause restricts the update to only unclaimed rows. If the row is already claimed by a real auth user, the update doesn't happen (DO NOTHING effectively) → attacker's signup creates no profile for them → staff_role() NULL → denied.

But there's a problem: if the owner re-creates an auth user for a username whose old auth user was DELETED (so the profile row still references the deleted auth user id), the row looks "unclaimed" (old id not in auth.users) → re-link works. That's actually desirable.

Also the attacker-signs-up-as-unclaimed-seeded-profile case: attacker claims e.g. 'inventory' seeded row. But with role now hardcoded to 'sales' on conflict... no wait, on conflict the role isn't changed (SET only touches id, is_active, updated_at), so the attacker would inherit 'inventory' role from the seeded row. Hmm. Is that acceptable? Only if public signup is on AND there's an unclaimed seeded profile with a privileged role. After the owner's setup, all 5 seeded profiles are claimed. So the window is essentially nil. But to be extra safe, on conflict we could also reset role to 'sales':

```sql
ON CONFLICT (username) DO UPDATE
SET id = EXCLUDED.id,
    role = 'sales',
    is_active = TRUE,
    updated_at = now()
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM auth.users u WHERE u.id = profiles.id);
```

Wait, but if the owner legitimately re-links a re-created auth user for an employee who was 'accountant', resetting to 'sales' forces the owner to re-promote. Slight annoyance but SAFE and explicit. Given the owner already promotes via the app (line 310 shows they do exactly this for 'admin'), it's consistent. Hmm, but resetting role on re-link could confuse the owner.

Let me think about what's really the threat model and keep it proportionate:
- Primary vuln: attacker takes over a CLAIMED profile (esp. super_admin 'admin'). → Fixed by the WHERE NOT EXISTS guard.
- Secondary: attacker claims an UNCLAIMED seeded privileged profile. → Requires public signup ON + unclaimed privileged row. Post-setup, none exist. The `role = 'sales'` reset closes it fully at the cost of a re-promote step on legitimate re-links.

Actually — simpler thought: why keep `is_active = TRUE` at all? If re-linking, the row's existing is_active should be respected (the owner may have suspended it). Setting is_active = TRUE unconditionally is itself a vuln (reactivation). Let me remove `is_active = TRUE` from the SET and just link the id. If the owner suspended the profile and deleted the auth user, then re-created the auth user, the profile stays suspended — correct fail-closed behavior, and the owner reactivates from the app.

Hmm, but there's the `is_active = TRUE` original intent: when the owner re-creates a user, they want it active. But security says: don't auto-reactivate. The app's Employees tab toggle is one click. Fail-closed wins.

So my fix:
```sql

RETURNS TRIGGER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
BEGIN
  -- C-4: الدور لا يؤخذ من بيانات المستخدم (user_metadata) أبداً — الموظف
```
